test_title: Most Repeated 2025 General Science PYQ Subject Test - 01
subject: gk
question: If the power of a lens is –4 D, which of the following is true about the lens?

options.text: It is a convex lens of focal length 2.5 m.
It is a convex lens of focal length 25 cm.
It is a concave lens of focal length 0.4 m.
It is a concave lens of focal length 25 cm.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It is a concave lens of focal length 25 cm.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **power of a lens** is defined as the reciprocal of its **focal length** (f) in meters. It represents the degree of **convergence** or **divergence** of light rays falling on it.
 
• The formula to calculate the power of a lens is **P = 1/f**, where **P** is the power in **Dioptres (D)** and **f** is the focal length in **meters (m)**.
 
• Given the power **P = -4 D**. To find the focal length, we use **f = 1/P**. Substituting the value, we get **f = 1/(-4) = -0.25 meters**.
 
• To convert the focal length from **meters** to **centimeters**, we multiply by **100**. Thus, **-0.25 m × 100 = -25 cm**.
